subject: Request: Successor retention credit exception for Helios Labs — exec clearance
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@helioslabs.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Successor retention credit exception for Helios Labs — exec clearance

Hi Grace / Kimberly,

Quick context: Helios Labs (renewing Aug 1) just notified us they're evaluating an alternate provider because of unit economics in high-seq workloads. They've been a multi-year customer and are contractually eligible for standard renewal pricing, but the account exec and CS believe a short-term "successor retention" credit (not a permanent price change) will materially increase renewal probability and upsell momentum for Q4.

Ask: I'm requesting executive-level clearance to offer a time-boxed retention credit structured as follows: 40% credit on net usage for first 2 months post-renewal, 20% credit month 3, and a hard cap of $120k total credit. The credit triggers are tied to a renewal signature and a minimum committed monthly usage floor.

Attachments: helios_retention_model.xlsx (forecast / revenue impact), proposed_amendment_redline.pdf, customer-thread-quote.eml

Why this is different from a typical onboarding credit: Helios is mid-enterprise with a demonstrated expansion path into two product verticals; losing them creates a measurable churn risk to roadmap integrations. Our modeling shows the credit pays back inside 9 months if we retain the account and preserve the expansion trajectory.

Can you review and advise whether we can approve this exception under a VP/CFO signoff path (I can route the DocuSign once approved). If you'd like a 15-min sync, I can jump on immediately.

Thanks,
Markus
--
Markus Klein
Account Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0186

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Successor retention credit exception for Helios Labs — exec clearance

Thanks for the clear summary, Markus. I reviewed the model quickly — good to see the payback sensitivity included. A few specific follow-ups before I escalate to Aditya for CFO signoff: 

- Please add a simple clause that the credit is "non-recurring" and only applies if the customer signs the renewal without additional structural price concessions (i.e., no change to list rates).
- Confirm that legal has reviewed the proposed amendment language on the redline (I see placeholders).
- Can we reduce the total credit cap to $100k unless Kimberly objects? That gives us more upside if expansion happens.

Kimberly, can you weigh in on the cap and whether accounting/legal have any material blocking concerns for revenue recognition or ASC implications?

If those bullets are addressed I will route to Aditya with a recommended approval.

Grace
--
Grace O'Connor
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@helioslabs.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Successor retention credit exception for Helios Labs — exec clearance

Grace — thanks, quick updates inline: 

- Non-recurring clause: Added language in the amendment redline (see attached). It explicitly states the credit is a one-time, nonrenewing concession tied to the Aug 1 renewal signature.
- Legal review: Legal (Laura Bennett) did an initial read and flagged two minor formatting items; redline updated to remove placeholders. I've asked legal to sign off on final, they'll be on the DocuSign package.
- Cap: We can accept $100k as the maximum credit cap. Updated the model to reflect that scenario (tab: "Cap100k").

Also added a conservative churn-reduction scenario and a weighted ARR retention estimate — both show retention value surpasses the credit within 6–8 months under mid-case expansion.

Next step: if you approve, please route to Aditya and copy me; I'll coordinate DocuSign and prepare the billing impact worksheet for finance.

Thanks,
Markus

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Successor retention credit exception for Helios Labs — exec clearance

Markus / Grace — I'm fine with $100k cap provided we include the following controls: 

1) Obvious acceptance criteria for the usage floor (documented in the amendment).
2) Billing to recognize credits only after usage is validated month-over-month (no up-front cash application).
3) Accounting will require a brief memo describing the commercial rationale for the concession for our revenue backup; I can draft that if helpful.

I have a quick question for Markus: is the credit effective only against usage (consumption) or does it also apply to seats / committed spend? Please confirm — the model currently assumes consumption only.

If consumption-only, I will be comfortable signing off and we can escalate to Aditya.

Kimberly
--
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal <legal@redwood.com>, Billing <billing@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Successor retention credit exception for Helios Labs — exec clearance

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the updated materials. I reviewed the redline and the financial model (Cap = $100k, consumption-only credit, non-recurring). Approve with conditions: 

1) Final legal signoff on the amendment language and signature block before sending to the customer.
2) Billing to implement a month-over-month validation check and hold-back process; credits issued only after verification. 
3) A one-paragraph CFO memo (Kimberly offered to draft) to attach to the revenue backup.

Markus: proceed to prepare the DocuSign packet and include the legal-approved redline and the billing worksheet. Copy Finance when sending the executed amendment for proper ledger treatment.

Granting approval now so the account team can move quickly — please execute the controls above and confirm back in this thread once DocuSign is sent.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Chief Financial Officer
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
